sys_atf_test.description: Inserts a case below the salary threshold with an ordinary job title, asserts all three flags are false and the evaluator returns not_required, then updates that same record to a high salary and a director title and asserts the before-update rule recomputes all three flags to true. Covers the condition-does-not-hold side on insert and the recompute behaviour on the separate update path.
